TOOLING BURST FL-4c — fire lane round 4c: no spikes, white-last dissolve, sampler parity, byte locks (Run C-5, FIRE LANE; conductor R-C5-117, defects F-C5-36 / F-C5-37). task_id "FL-4c".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4h (burst_v2: stretch, dissolve_order, erode), FL-4a, FL-4b and the new row "FL-4c — no spikes · white-last dissolve · sampler parity · byte locks" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/effect_kit.py (piece_stretch — the seeded 2.0..2.5 along-stretch; dissolve_order validation; the interleave block), export/godot_import.py (burst_v2 pieces phase after FL-4a/4b: stretch application, dissolve order, erosion; the interleave sampler), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v3/kit.json (+ _v2), tests/test_effect_kit.py, tests/test_godot_import.py (FL4BRuntimeTraceTests.test_engine_selections_match_portable_sampler_and_repeat_seed), tests/test_vfx_picker.py, fixtures/ (read; Part D).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

PART A — F-C5-36 NO SPIKES: the burst_v2 along-stretch (seeded 2.0–2.5×) turns the peak's arms into 5-BH spikes at f36 (Matt: the octopus, amplified). New kit-level field `pieces.stretch {along [1.2,1.4], across 0.9}` (validated: along in [1.0,2.6] ascending pair, across in [0.7,1.0]) overriding the template default; fire_burst_e0p_v3 = along [1.2,1.4]; interleave tongues stretch at 1.15 fixed. Other burst_v2 kits keep the template default (absent field = 2.0–2.5 / 0.85) — byte-identical. Trace clause: for v3 the max drawn radial extent of any body piece over its life ≤ 1.5× its peak extent; overall burst extent at f36 ≤ 4.5 BH (was ~5+).
PART B — F-C5-37 WHITE-LAST DISSOLVE: dissolve_order for v3 → [[0],[1],[2],[3]] (contour first, then dark, mid, WHITE LAST) so the burst ends white-hot into the ember ending (Matt: the white-hot centre is the best piece); erosion outside-in unchanged. Validate that any dissolve_order is a partition of {0,1,2,3}. Trace clause: at the last painted frame (age 25) the surviving painted pixels are ≥ 90 % band 3; no band-0 pixel survives past age 22.
PART C — SAMPLER PARITY (FL-4b's one red): the Python portable sampler in the test picks tongue id 8 where the engine picks 10 — the two RNG streams diverge. Rule: the ENGINE is the reference; the Python sampler must reproduce it exactly (port the engine's seeded draw order — selection, gap ranking, mirror, jitter, scale — verbatim; state the sequence in the docstring); never weaken the test. If Godot's RandomNumberGenerator cannot be reproduced bit-exactly in Python, replace the runtime draw with a documented xorshift/PCG the exporter emits in GDScript AND implements in Python (same seed → same ids on both), and prove it on 20 seeds.
PART D — byte locks re-opened (FL-1b diff rule); the catalogue lock stays red (E3-r1) — name it (18 kits now).

Apply Parts A/B to runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json (impact presentation: stretch, dissolve; provenance "R-C5-117 FL-4c") and fire_burst_e0p_v3/kit.json; _v2 untouched (comparison kit); primitives/pieces byte-identical.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/FL-4c/acceptance.json): the trace clauses with numbers; sampler parity on 20 seeds; 17 kits byte-identical (v3 kit.json only); full 18-kit catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0 (gl_compatibility); in-sandbox suite with the named tests green, remaining reds NAMED.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): stretch/dissolve validation + trace clauses; parity on 20 seeds; extend/realign only the named tests. DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any kit except fire_burst_e0p_v3/kit.json, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-4c/ and the spec's named fields; fixtures/ only for Part D. Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy. Confine Godot logs to runs/C-5/t3/FL-4c/.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-4c"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
